items.prompt:
'Add $8$ and $7$, then multiply by $2$' is
A) $(8 + 7) \times 2$
B) $8 + 7 \times 2$
C) $8 \times 7 + 2$
D) $8 + 7 + 2$

'$3$ times the sum of $4$ and $5$' is
A) $3 \times (4 + 5)$
B) $3 \times 4 + 5$
C) $3 + 4 + 5$
D) $(3 + 4) \times 5$

$(5 + 3) \div 2$ means
A) add $5$ and $3$, then divide by $2$
B) divide $5$ by $2$, then add $3$
C) $5 + 3 + 2$
D) $5 \times 3 \div 2$
items.answer: A) add $5$ and $3$, then divide by $2$

B) $10 - 6 \times 2$

A) greater than

'Half of the sum of $12$ and $8$' is
A) $(12 + 8) \div 2$
B) $12 + 8 \div 2$
C) $12 \div 2 + 8$
D) $(12 - 8) \div 2$

$3 \times (8 - 2)$ in words is
A) three times the difference of $8$ and $2$
B) three times $8$ minus $2$
C) $3 - 8 - 2$
D) $3 + 8 - 2$
items.answer: A) three times the difference of $8$ and $2$
